The front bumper cover on the vehicle is cracked across the left corner, with the left fog lamp bracket broken and the left fender
edge scuffed and pushed inward. The pattern of the damage matches the impact described for a collision while turning left.

plan is to replace the bumper cover, fog lamp bracket and fender, then refinish and recalibrate the affected sensors. The labor
hours on the estimate run a little high for this scope of work, so the shop should be asked to review them before approval.
